context: Tests whether the agent separates a monolithic README by audience: users get installation and first use, contributors get development and verification, and security reporters get the existing private route. Grade discoverability and factual preservation, not a fixed section template.

checklist.name: README hero section
checklist.description: README.md starts with a one-sentence purpose/description of the project (hero section is first or near-first)

checklist.name: First use easy to find
checklist.description: README.md places installation or quick-start instructions before deep architecture and development detail, so users can reach the first successful command without searching. No particular heading label is required.

checklist.name: README links out to CONTRIBUTING
checklist.description: README.md contains a link or pointer to CONTRIBUTING.md rather than re-stating contributor steps inline

checklist.name: README links out to SECURITY
checklist.description: README.md contains a link or pointer to SECURITY.md rather than re-stating security contact inline

checklist.name: No content duplication
checklist.description: Contributor setup steps (npm install, branch naming, PR process) appear in CONTRIBUTING.md but NOT duplicated in README.md

checklist.name: Contributor path clear
checklist.description: CONTRIBUTING.md makes prerequisites and setup easy to find before the reader needs pull-request or release guidance; no exact section template is required.

checklist.name: Contributor validation discoverable
checklist.description: CONTRIBUTING.md clearly identifies the actual tests or validation commands, such as npm test or npm run test:coverage, without requiring a particular section heading.

checklist.name: SECURITY private-first
checklist.description: SECURITY.md explicitly tells reporters NOT to open public issues for vulnerabilities

checklist.name: SECURITY contact present
checklist.description: SECURITY.md prominently includes the existing security email address as the private reporting route; no particular contact heading is required.

checklist.name: SECURITY focused
checklist.description: SECURITY.md stays focused on private reporting, supported scope, and disclosure boundaries without unrelated product or contributor material; no fixed line count is required.

checklist.name: Doc changes summary
checklist.description: doc-changes.md exists and lists at least two pieces of content that moved from README.md to another file
